_meta.description: Index of the 6 noon (noon Partners) report tables ingested by the reporting server. Query with query_report_data using a noon store ref WITH its marketplace (myStore-AE) — a ref without one is refused and the refusal lists the valid refs; scoping is by project_code (resolved from the caller's connected noon accounts), not store_id.
_meta.scope: project_code (resolved from the caller's connected noon accounts; never passed)
_meta.cadence: orders, finance, fbn_aging, product_views twice daily 04:00+16:00 UTC (0 4,16 * * *); catalog export daily 03:00 UTC, one marketplace at a time ~30 min apart; FBN catalog daily 05:00 UTC
_meta.notes: The store ref's marketplace is injected as a filter on every table with a per-row marketplace: country_code on catalog_export, fbn_aging, product_views; market_place_country_code on orders (blank-country rows excluded). finance and the FBN catalog are account-wide and NOT filtered: filter finance.marketplace (derived from contract_title NOON-XX) yourself; the FBN catalog has no marketplace. report_date='all' + the table's own date column everywhere, except the two catalogs, whose date IS report_date: report_date='latest' = the current copy (per marketplace for the catalog export).

tables.marketplace_column: market_place_country_code (auto-filtered from the store ref; blank-country rows excluded)
tables.description: noon order items: status, fulfillment (is_fulfilled_by_noon), shipment_nr/awb_nr, delivery windows. marketplace = per-row country.

tables.marketplace_column: country_code (derived per row from contract_title NOON-XX, else the currency; auto-filtered from the ref's marketplace — rows naming none are left out)
tables.description: Transaction View Report (Item Level): item-level finance transactions, all money VAT-inclusive numeric(16,2). Account-wide single report; marketplace derived per-row from contract_title (NOON-AE->AE, ALL when unparseable) — filter marketplace or contract_title. Sum total for net payout.

Daily FBN inventory aging snapshot per marketplace. One row per partner_barcode (a sku can have many; sku may be empty with partner_barcode=UNIDENTIFIED). Single 181-365d bucket (quantity_181_365d). Query latest snapshot for current stock.
tables.current_stock: report_date='all', then filter snapshot_date = MAX(snapshot_date); never sum across snapshot dates (the table holds several)

tables.description: Daily product views & sales per marketplace. asp_shipped is a PRICE not a percent; conversion_visitors_percentage can exceed 100; sales columns sparse.

tables.strategy: noon_export (live + not_live, one marketplace at a time ~30 min apart, written together under one report_date)
tables.marketplace_column: country_code (= marketplace; auto-filtered from the store ref)
tables.description: Full noon catalog per marketplace per day (every partner SKU, live and not live): partner_sku, sku_child, noon_title, noon_brand, prices, sale window, stock, noon_status live/not_live, offer_status_reason (why not live; sometimes blank). noon shares a listing across marketplaces but prices and stock differ, so each marketplace has its own copy. Current catalog = report_date='latest' (newest copy per marketplace). Skeleton not-live rows (no family/brand/title) exist; noon_price_max 99999 = no cap.

tables.marketplace_column: marketplace (constant 'ALL' — account-wide, no marketplace dimension; not filtered)
tables.event_date_column: report_date (= last date the row was seen in a pull)
tables.description: FBN-eligible product catalog: partner_sku <-> noon sku, title, storage_type enum, CDN image_url. The noon image/title lookup — JOIN on sku (or partner_sku) to add =IMAGE() thumbnail columns, exactly like the Amazon catalog pattern. Rolling UPSERT: current catalog = report_date='latest' (newest report_date); rows absent from newer pulls keep their old report_date (no longer FBN-eligible). For every listing (not just FBN-eligible) use rpt_noon_catalog_export.
tables.image_pattern: write partner_sku+sku+title+image_url to a hidden _raw_noon_catalog helper tab; column A of the visible tab uses MAP/ARRAYFORMULA IMAGE() joined by sku with IDENTICAL WHERE/ORDER/LIMIT as the data spill (see sellersheet-sheets reference/image-pattern.md)
